verdict.rationale: The pricing page says IVS offers server-side composition, or client-side composition, of a multi-participant stage into a single channel broadcast. Separately, the EventBridge docs show individual publishers being recorded to S3. The evidence does not show the composed output being recorded, and it documents no layouts. missing for 10: documented recording of the composed multi-participant output, documented layout options (grid/PiP etc.), in-depth composition docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-participant recordings can be composed into a single output with documented layout options

citations.quote: When broadcasting the stage to a channel, you have the option of client-side composition at no extra cost or [server-side composition](#Server-side_Composition) which incurs an additional hourly rate.
A publisher has connected to the stage and is being recorded to S3.
